messages.author: 389c76ab3814e27b
messages.subject: Dynamic UI & Submit Button
parts: At the moment, once a Submit button has been added to the UI, it seems to control all the input fields, including the dynamic ones. For instance, if I create a drop down list for the user to select a data set, and another drop down list of which the options vary based on the data set the user has selected, the dynamic drop down list would not change unless the user has pressed the Submit button. Is it possible to make the Dynamic UI and the Submit button coexist in a way that the Submit button only controls part of the input fields? Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Dynamic UI & Submit Button
parts: It's currently not very easy. You can fake it with an actionButton (from the shinyIncubator package, https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-incubator) and some gymnastics in server.R, but this really ought to be easier right out of the box.
